t: Robust Magnusson box beam level provides high accuracy for various construction and fitting tasks. The spirit level features anodised aluminium construction to ensure durability, with a V-groove magnetic base which allows for secure, hands-free operation on metal surfaces and pipes; ideal for plumbing or steelwork. Solid block vials deliver precise horizontal and vertical measurements with 0.5 mm/m accuracy. Designed for the trade, it includes shock-resistant rubber end caps for impact protection and an ergonomic hand grip for comfortable use, providing reliable performance on any job site.
b: Ergonomic Hand Grip For Comfortable Use
